participation.context: Read the head of the roll and did not invent a cue to fill the holes.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You held the justice's roll, counted eight speeches, and saw that the cues were gone to the finger.

title: Looked at a part with the cues worn off

participation.context: Spoke the eight lines and refused to call it a triumph.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Dried four times in the same place and apologised to Garnish, Heminges, Pope, and William.
participation.name: Richard Cowley

participation.context: Stood in a doublet that would fit a rake, and gave the unkind thanks.
participation.name: John Sincler

participation.context: Stopped prompting and read the play aloud.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Stood padded to a barrel, and said Sincler needs none.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Looked at the sun, said the Rose has Hercules again, and broke them at eleven.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Walked the crosses and did not speak.
participation.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

relations.quote: He needs none. He is the before, and I'm the after.

story.body: You spoke eight lines of a justice without a miss, took a sarcastic thanks, and left at eleven with the play no better. Cowley had apologised to four men for one hole. Kemp had not come.

relations.quote: He needs none. He is the before, and I'm the after.

title: Spoke eight lines of a justice in the old Knave
